candidates.title: Post Training Quantization of Large Language Models with Microscaling Formats
candidates.reason: Systematic LLM post-training quantization study combining SmoothQuant/AWQ/GPTQ with microscaling formats for low-bit deployment.

candidates.title: Reducing Transformer Key-Value Cache Size with Cross-Layer Attention
candidates.reason: Cross-Layer Attention shares KV heads between adjacent layers, extending MQA/GQA to further reduce KV-cache memory while preserving accuracy.

candidates.title: A Comprehensive Survey of Accelerated Generation Techniques in Large Language Models
candidates.reason: Focused survey of LLM generation-acceleration techniques, useful for organizing speculative decoding and related inference acceleration lineages.

candidates.title: PerLLM: Personalized Inference Scheduling with Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Diverse LLM Services
candidates.reason: Edge-cloud LLM inference scheduler jointly optimizing service constraints, resource allocation, throughput, and energy cost.
